tagline: The largest and most geographically diverse publicly-traded water and wastewater utility company in the United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Regulated revenue represents over 90% of total revenue and is the primary structural driver of the company, driven by authorized rate increases and infrastructure investments protected by regulation.

kpis.name: Regulated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from water and wastewater activities subject to tariff regulation.
kpis.description: Regulated revenue increased 9.9% in 2025 to $4.723 billion, driven by authorized rate increases (+$406M) and acquisitions (+$49M).
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by authorized rate increases and acquisitions.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue of the company, including regulated and non-regulated activities.
kpis.description: Total revenue of $5.140 billion in 2025 (regulated activities: $4.723B + other: $0.417B), up 9.7% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Robust growth driven by regulated and other activities.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income after taxes attributable to common shareholders.
kpis.description: Net income reached $1.137 billion in 2025 (including regulated income of $1.137B and non-regulated loss of $26M), up 6.8% compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Sustained profitability growth despite rising costs.

kpis.name: Infrastructure Investments
kpis.explanation: Spending on infrastructure investments to modernize water and wastewater networks.
kpis.description: The company is investing heavily in its infrastructure, with capex of approximately $1.5 billion annually to support growth and modernization.
kpis.signal: High level of investment supported by regulation and accelerated recovery mechanisms.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The company employs approximately 7,000 professionals across the United States, serving 14 million people in 24 states.
kpis.signal: Stable workforce supporting continuous operational growth.

kpis.name: Debt Issuance
kpis.explanation: Amount of new long-term debt issued to finance investments.
kpis.description: In 2026, subsidiary AWCC issued $700 million of 10-year senior notes to finance infrastructure investments.
kpis.signal: Active financing of growth through capital markets.

kpis.name: Billed Water Volumes
kpis.explanation: Total volume of water billed to customers in millions of gallons.
kpis.description: Billed water volumes decreased 0.8% in 2025 to 333.2 billion gallons compared to 2024, impacted by drier weather (estimated $36M revenue loss).
kpis.signal: Slight decline due to drier weather conditions.

kpis.name: Acquisitions Impact
kpis.explanation: Contribution of acquisitions to operating revenue.
kpis.description: Acquisitions contributed $49 million to regulated revenue growth in 2025, representing approximately 11.4% of total revenue growth.
kpis.signal: Active external growth in the regulated segment.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year. Key indicator for income-oriented investors.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total of cash returned to shareholders: dividends paid plus share buybacks (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income paid out as dividends. Above 80% indicates a potentially unsustainable dividend.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of 1.879 Bn USD last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.description: Diluted EPS extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Diluted EPS of 5.69 USD last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: PFAS Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to new regulations on PFAS (per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances), which could result in significant costs to comply with new federal and state standards.

risks.title: Merger with Essential
risks.score_rationale: The merger with Essential could have a significant impact on operations and integration risks. The company incurred $13M in merger-related costs in 2025.

risks.title: Compliance Costs
risks.score_rationale: The company must comply with numerous federal and state regulations regarding drinking water, wastewater, and environmental standards, resulting in significant and ongoing costs.

risks.title: Environmental Risks Related to PFAS
risks.score_rationale: PFAS are emerging contaminants in drinking water that require costly treatment technologies. Pending federal PFAS regulations (MCL) could impose significant investment requirements.

risks.title: Dependence on Regulation and Regulatory Lag
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on regulatory approval for rate increases and investment recovery. Regulatory lag limits the ability to immediately recover invested costs.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. The company does not position AI as a strategic lever.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, or predictive analytics tools
Absence of KPIs related to digitalization or technological innovation
Focus on regulation, infrastructure, and traditional services
